title: DoorDash Keeps 47 Cents of a $34 Order
description:
Your DoorDash order: about 34 dollars. DoorDash's profit: just 47 cents.

Sources:
- DoorDash Q3 2026 earnings press release: https://s22.q4cdn.com/280253921/files/content_files/Q3-2026-Earnings-Press-Release.pdf
- Wikipedia: DoorDash: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DoorDash

Q3 2026: 993 million orders, $33.9 billion Marketplace GOV (about $34.18 per order, our math), net revenue margin 13.6%, record GAAP net income of $466 million (about 47 cents per order, our math). Not financial advice.

#shorts #doordash #delivery #howtheymakemoney

scenes.narration: Your DoorDash order: about 34 dollars. DoorDash's profit: just 47 cents.
Its revenue? Only 13.6 percent of the order.

visual.label: DoorDash revenue as % of order value, Q3 2026

scenes.narration: But the rest goes to restaurants, Dashers, tips and taxes.
Then DoorDash pays its own costs. That leaves the 47 cents.
Still, times nearly a billion orders, that's a record 466 million dollars.
